User-agent rotation cycles through multiple agents across multiple requests

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'max_depth' => 1, 'max_pages' => 3, 'user_agents' => ['Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) TestAgent-1', 'Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15) TestAgent-2'] }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.crawl(engine, url)
puts result.pages.length.inspect
```
